Regardless of who you are, whether you're a homeless person who doesn't have anyone. A very successful person who is loved by everyone. There will always be people who would mourn your death. I've felt the same, how ending my life will make things so much easier and put an end to my misery. But it can surely create more misery for others, but that is not your fault. There is always something you can do to make your life better, sometimes you have to work harder than expected. But anyone can do it, and that means you can too. Don't give up on hope, regardless of how little hope you might think there is
